title: The Lakeshore Esports Bracket
blurb: The school esports club booked the library after hours: a double-elimination bracket, and a very long argument about seeding.

text.intro:
The school esports club booked the library after hours: a double-elimination bracket, and a very long argument about seeding.
Six players are involved. Determine each player's exit round, game, gear and tag.
- **Player**: Beau, Priyanka, Gus Villalobos, Oksana, Mina and Tyrell.
- **Exit round** (listed from earlier to later): round one, round two, round three, round four, round five and round six.
- **Game**: the puzzle brawler, the kart racer, the soccer sim, the farming sim, the block-builder and the rhythm game.
- **Gear**: a borrowed controller, the club's old mouse, a tournament pad, a split keyboard, an arcade stick and a trackball.
- **Tag**: Sparrow, Pocketwatch, Downhill, Marmalade, BlueHeron and Static.
Every player has a different exit round, game, gear and tag, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The player who mains the block-builder and Tyrell are exactly one round apart in exit round order, in one direction or the other. (b) Gus Villalobos is knocked out in round two.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who mains the rhythm game and round five are exactly one round apart in exit round order, in one direction or the other. (b) The player who plays with the club's old mouse is not knocked out in round five.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The player who mains the soccer sim is exactly one round earlier than Beau, with no exit round in between. (b) Oksana is knocked out in round two.
Round one is exactly one round earlier than the player who mains the soccer sim, with no exit round in between.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who goes by BlueHeron and round three are exactly one round apart in exit round order, in one direction or the other. (b) The player who mains the kart racer goes by BlueHeron.
The player who plays with a borrowed controller and round five are exactly four rounds apart in exit round order.
Tyrell is later than round two in exit round order.
Round three is exactly one round earlier than the player who plays with a split keyboard, with no exit round in between.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who goes by BlueHeron and round three are exactly one round apart in exit round order, in one direction or the other. (b) The player who mains the puzzle brawler and the player who goes by Pocketwatch are exactly two rounds apart in exit round order.
The player who mains the farming sim and the player who goes by Marmalade are exactly two rounds apart in exit round order.
The player who plays with a borrowed controller and Beau both sit at odd-numbered rounds or both at even-numbered rounds.
If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) Tyrell is earlier than the player who mains the puzzle brawler in exit round order. (b) Priyanka mains the block-builder.
The player who mains the soccer sim and the player who plays with a tournament pad are exactly one round apart in exit round order, in one direction or the other.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) One of the player who mains the rhythm game and the player who plays with a trackball sits at an odd-numbered exit round and the other at an even-numbered exit round. (b) One of the player who plays with a trackball and Mina sits at an odd-numbered exit round and the other at an even-numbered exit round.
The player who goes by Downhill is earlier than the player who mains the block-builder in exit round order.
The player who mains the puzzle brawler and Oksana both sit at odd-numbered rounds or both at even-numbered rounds.
The player who goes by BlueHeron is exactly one round earlier than Gus Villalobos, with no exit round in between.
The player who plays with a trackball falls somewhere between the player who goes by Downhill and the player who goes by Sparrow in exit round order.
Beau falls somewhere between the player who mains the puzzle brawler and the player who goes by Static in exit round order.
The player who plays with a trackball is exactly one round earlier than the player who mains the kart racer, with no exit round in between.
The player who plays with a tournament pad does not go by Marmalade.
